title: The research task runs on a governed history, each party held to its grants
note: Stage 2, S2-3. GR1 removes the roots the decision proof's prefix hands the task reader, which decides a scientific result's admission. GR2 to GR5 remove what makes the world governed: the mode, the grants it is given, the genesis declaration, and the signing. tests/test_governed_research_run.py runs the adversarial evaluation's legitimate task on the governed history and removes each grant in turn.

mutations.name: GR1_the_prefix_hands_no_roots_to_the_task_reader
mutations.find:
self.authenticator = authenticator
        self.roles = roles
        self._events = [e for e in events if e.seq <= upto]
mutations.replace:
self.authenticator = None
        self.roles = roles
        self._events = [e for e in events if e.seq <= upto]
mutations.rationale: a governed scientific result's decision proof is not accepted: the task reader on the prefix folds nothing, so no verification task stands behind the admission

mutations.name: GR2_the_world_is_never_governed
mutations.rationale: a world asked to be governed runs on an unauthenticated history that declares nothing

mutations.name: GR3_the_world_ignores_the_grants_it_is_given
mutations.find: roles = RR.RoleRegistry([RR.RoleGrant(*g) for g in grants])
mutations.replace: roles = RR.RoleRegistry([RR.RoleGrant(*g) for g in GOVERNED_GRANTS])
mutations.rationale: a world given fewer grants runs with all of them, so no grant is shown to be needed

mutations.name: GR4_the_history_declares_nothing
mutations.rationale: a governed world's history declares no registries at genesis, so a reader without them reads it

mutations.name: GR5_the_world_writes_unsigned
mutations.rationale: a governed world's writers hold no keys, and its first unsigned record is refused
